_help: VULPHEX's brains, by job. CLAUDE is the TEACHER: it handles reason + code_reasoning (reproducing repos, writing fine-tune lessons) when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else it falls back to NVIDIA 'big'. Fast NVIDIA handles chat + study (instant). The uncensored Qwen (Kaggle GPU) handles plan + coach with no refusals. Keys from the environment: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Claude), NVIDIA_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY. On Kaggle, kaggle.py reads the Secrets named Claude/NVIDIA_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY into these. Change the claude model id below if your account uses a different one.
